thread:
maria_cs: Meridian reached out with a custom re-ranker onboarding request — trained on their catalog + click logs. They want hosted first but may accept Dedicated for SLA. Asking about PHI/PII handling and whether our 8-bit quantized runtime is compatible.

mason_ml: looping in MLOps. Do they want Hosted inference or Private/Dedicated? Also need model artifact format (TorchScript / ONNX) and total size.

maria_cs: Hosted preferred. Artifact is ONNX (~12GB). They already ran a coarse int8 quantization. Big ask: they do NOT want raw customer logs sent outside their cloud.

ben_eng: ONNX is supported but we need to run a compatibility smoke test. For quantized models we have two paths — dynamic quant kernels or static kernel path. If they provide calibration tables and example inputs that speeds things up. I'll prepare a compatibility checklist.

laura_pm: flagging renewal risk: Meridian is up for Q3 renewal; onboarding delays could impact their decision. Recommend offering an enablement + handoff session and prioritizing the eval window.

mason_ml: proposed eval plan: 1) ingest artifact + sample (no-PHI) dataset 2) smoke compatibility (runtime, correctness) 3) safety sweep (PII leakage tests, label bleed) 4) perf benchmarks (p95 latency, throughput) 5) quality evals (nDCG, precision@k) 6) canary rollout. ETA: ~10 business days after we receive artifacts.

maria_cs: Meridian contact (external): @alex_meridian said they can either provide a redacted dataset or let us run evals in their VPC. They asked us not to copy production logs off their account.

ben_eng: VPC-hosted evals recommended for privacy. If they cannot do VPC, synthetic/redacted dataset is OK but may underrepresent edge cases. For VPC we'll need an infra sandbox + access window. @devops can you advise on lead time?

devops: creating infra ticket INF-5731. We'll need customer's org id, subnet CIDR for the private endpoint, and whether they require HSM/KMS integration. Estimated spin-up: 3 business days once details are provided.

maria_cs: action: I'll collect three items from Meridian by EOB Tue — (1) org id, (2) redacted sample dataset (CSV, <=5k rows) or VPC approval, (3) S3 IAM policy or confirmation they don't want logs exported.

laura_pm: owners: Maria to collect artifacts, Ben to run smoke tests, Mason to run safety and quality evals. I'll schedule a 60-min enablement once smoke passes. Also note: prioritize this account for Q3 renewal outreach.

mason_ml: I'll add eval templates to the ops runbook and include automated nDCG/precision@10 scripts. Quick snippet: ```python
# eval snippet
preds = model.run(batch)
score = ndcg(preds, labels)
```

maria_cs: Meridian is onboard with this plan and appreciates the VPC option. Thanks team :party-parrot: :thumbsup:

deploybot: Deploy bot: INF-5731 created by devops; linked to thread 3132109876
